title: Carter purge of senior CIA officers who ran legacy program
summary: Matthew Pines tells of Carter purge of senior CIA officers who ran legacy program, about 1977 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: you had in the CIA, just to take that as a concrete example, you had Carter essentially purge like the entire senior ranks of the CIA when he came into office. And what did those hundreds of senior CIA officers do? Many of whom were probably presiding over aspects of the legacy program in an official capacity,

plain: Matthew Pines, a national security analyst, said on Jesse Michels's podcast that when Jimmy Carter became president in 1977 he purged almost the whole senior ranks of the CIA, the US spy agency. Pines suggests that many of those hundreds of officers were probably running parts of the "legacy program", meaning a long-running secret effort said to handle UFO material, and he asks what they went on to do after they left, since it would mean the secret slipped out of official hands.
